title: sida diantha
intro: Sida diantha, commonly known as the Heartseed or Heartseed Plant, is a plant species belonging to the family Malvaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation and fighting against microbial infections, due to its health benefits of boosting the immune system and treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Sida diantha include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents present in the plant are flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
